description: This file defines the ReportNotFoundException class, which extends a custom runtime exception used within the Fineract project to signal that a report resource could not be found.

classes.name: ReportNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a report resource was not found, either by name or ID.

methods.name: ReportNotFoundException(String reportName)
methods.description: Constructs an exception indicating that a report with the given name was not found.

methods.name: ReportNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructs an exception indicating that a report parameter with the given ID was not found.
